jobs.description:
Du liebst starke Maschinen, moderne Technik und abwechslungsreiche Einsätze? Dann bist du bei Liebherr genau richtig. Als Service-Techniker sorgst du dafür, dass unsere modernsten Baumaschinen auf Baustellen in der Nordostschweiz Höchstleistungen erbringen. Kein Tag ist wie der andere – und genau das macht den Job so spannend. Das sind deine Aufgaben
• Du sorgst mit Wartungs-, Reparatur- und Revisionsarbeiten dafür, dass unsere Liebherr-Erdbewegungsgeräte jederzeit einsatzbereit sind.
• Du gehst technischen Störungen auf den Grund und bringst die Maschinen schnell wieder zum Laufen.
• Du führst Garantiearbeiten sowie technische Nachrüstungen und Änderungen gemäss den aktuellen Service-Informationen aus.
• Du machst Neu-, Miet- und Sondergeräte fit für den Einsatz – von der Bereitstellung über die Installation bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
• Du bist bei unseren Kunden vor Ort, stehst ihnen mit deinem technischen Know-how zur Seite und sorgst für einen erstklassigen Service.
• Du dokumentierst deine Einsätze in Wartungs-, Inspektions- und Servicerapporten.
• Du begeisterst unsere Kunden mit deiner professionellen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Das bringst du mit
• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Baumaschinenmechaniker EFZ, Landmaschinenmechaniker EFZ, Automobil-Mechatroniker EFZ Fachrichtung Nutzfahrzeuge oder Motorgerätemechaniker EFZ
• Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Baumaschinen oder verwandter Fahrzeugtechnik
• Eine selbstständige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, Teamgeist und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein
• Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und ein sicheres Auftreten
• Wohnort vorzugsweise in der Nordostschweiz (ZH, SH, TG) oder den angrenzenden Kantonen AG, ZG, SG, AR und AI sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.
• Führerausweis Kategorie B (BE sowie Stapler-, Hubarbeitsbühnen- oder Klimaprüfung sind ein Plus)
• Bereitschaft für Reisetätigkeit, flexible Einsätze, Pikettdienst und technische Weiterbildung Darauf kannst du dich freuen
• Spannende Maschinen und Technik, die begeistert
• Flexibilität durch moderne Arbeitszeiten und Infrastruktur
• Eigenes Servicefahrzeug und moderne Arbeitsmittel
• Ein starkes Team in einer erfolgreichen Firmengruppe
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und laufende technische Weiterbildungen
• Attraktive Sozialleistungen und Benefits Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG mit Sitz in Reiden (Schweiz) ist verantwortlich für den Vertrieb und Service von Erdbewegungs- und Materialumschlagmaschinen, Turmdrehkranen, Betontechnik, Spezialtiefbaumaschinen sowie Mobil- und Raupenkranen in der Schweiz. Standort Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ami macchine forti, tecnologia moderna e applicazioni varie? Allora sei esattamente al Liebherr. In qualità di tecnico di servizio, si assicura che le nostre macchine di costruzione all'avanguardia nei cantieri della Svizzera nord-est forniscono le migliori prestazioni. Nessun giorno è come l'altro – e questo è esattamente ciò che rende il lavoro così eccitante. Questi sono i tuoi compiti
• Con il lavoro di manutenzione, riparazione e ispezione, si assicura che i nostri dispositivi Liebherr movimento terra sono pronti per l'uso in ogni momento.
• Si arriva al fondo di guasti tecnici e rapidamente ottenere le macchine in esecuzione di nuovo.
• Effettuate lavori di garanzia, oltre a retrofit tecnici e modifiche in base alle attuali informazioni di servizio.
• Realizzi nuovi, noleggio e attrezzature speciali per l'uso – dalla fornitura all'installazione alla messa in servizio.
• Siete in loco con i nostri clienti, supportarli con il vostro know-how tecnico e fornire un servizio di prima classe.
• Documenti le tue assegnazioni nei rapporti di manutenzione, ispezione e servizio.
• Ispirate i nostri clienti con il vostro modo professionale e orientato alla soluzione di lavorare e costruire relazioni a lungo termine. Lo porti con te.
• Formazione completa come meccanico di macchine edili EFZ, meccanico di macchine agricole EFZ, specialista di meccatronica automobilistica EFZ specializzazione in veicoli commerciali o attrezzature motore meccanico EFZ
• Idealmente, prima esperienza professionale nel campo delle macchine da costruzione o della relativa tecnologia del veicolo
• Un metodo di lavoro indipendente, affidabile, spirito di squadra e un forte senso di responsabilità
• Gioia del contatto diretto del cliente e un aspetto sicuro
• Luogo di residenza preferibilmente nella Svizzera nord-est (ZH, SH, TG) o nei cantoni adiacenti AG, ZG, SG, AR e AI, nonché una buona conoscenza del tedesco.
• Categoria B patente di guida (BE così come camion, piattaforma di sollevamento o aria condizionata test sono un plus)
• Prontezza per viaggi, assegnazioni flessibili, servizio di piketting e formazione tecnica
• Macchine e tecnologie emozionanti che ispirano
• Flessibilità attraverso moderne ore di lavoro e infrastrutture
• Veicolo di servizio privato e attrezzature di lavoro moderne
• Una squadra forte in un gruppo di successo di aziende
• Opportunità di sviluppo e formazione tecnica continua
• Benefici e vantaggi sociali attraenti Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per qualsiasi domanda, contattare Susanne Sulzer. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, con sede a Reiden (Svizzera), è responsabile per le vendite e il servizio di macchine movimento terra e movimentazione di materiali, gru a torre, tecnologia di cemento, speciali macchine edili sotterranee e gru mobili e crawler in Svizzera. Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Svizzera (CH) Contatta Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00
descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you love strong machines, modern technology and varied applications? Then you are exactly right at Liebherr. As a service technician, you ensure that our state-of-the-art construction machines on construction sites in northeast Switzerland provide top performance. No day is like the other – and that’s exactly what makes the job so exciting. These are your tasks
• With maintenance, repair and inspection work, you ensure that our Liebherr earthmoving devices are ready for use at all times.
• You get to the bottom of technical failures and quickly get the machines running again.
• You carry out warranty work as well as technical retrofits and changes according to the current service information.
• You make new, rental and special equipment fit for use – from provision to installation to commissioning.
• You are on site with our customers, support them with your technical know-how and provide a first-class service.
• You document your assignments in maintenance, inspection and service reports.
• You inspire our customers with your professional and solution-oriented way of working and build long-term relationships. You bring that with you
• Completed training as a construction machinery mechanic EFZ, agricultural machinery mechanic EFZ, automotive mechatronics specialist EFZ specialisation in commercial vehicles or engine equipment mechanic EFZ
• Ideally, first professional experience in the field of construction machinery or related vehicle technology
• An independent, reliable working method, team spirit and a strong sense of responsibility
• Joy of direct customer contact and a secure appearance
• Place of residence preferably in northeast Switzerland (ZH, SH, TG) or the adjacent cantons AG, ZG, SG, AR and AI as well as very good knowledge of German.
• Category B driving licence (BE as well as truck, lifting platform or air conditioning test are a plus)
• Readiness for travel, flexible assignments, piketting service and technical training You can look forward to
• Exciting machines and technology that inspires
• Flexibility through modern working hours and infrastructure
• Own service vehicle and modern work equipment
• A strong team in a successful group of companies
• Development opportunities and ongoing technical training
• Attractive social benefits and benefits Have we aroused your interest? We look forward to your online application. For any questions, please contact Susanne Sulzer. One passion. Many opportunities. The company Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, based in Reiden (Switzerland), is responsible for the sales and service of earthmoving and material handling machines, tower cranes, concrete technology, special underground construction machines and mobile and crawler cranes in Switzerland. Location Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Switzerland (CH) Contact Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

jobs.description:
Tu souhaites découvrir comment fonctionne un moteur ? Le monde des machines éveille ta curiosité ? Tu as envie d'intégrer une équipe dynamique d'apprenti·es dans un environnement moderne et à la pointe de la technologie ? Liebherr Machines Bulle SA forme des apprenti·es depuis 1981 et chaque année une vingtaine de jeunes obtiennent leur CFC après 3 ou 4 ans d'apprentissage dans notre entreprise. Durée de l’apprentissage : 3 ans – du 1er août 2027 au 31 juillet 2030 Tes missions Derrière chaque moteur qui quitte notre site se trouve toute une chaîne logistique. Pendant tes trois années d’apprentissage :
• Tu décharges, contrôles et réceptionnes les marchandises livrées
• Tu évalues régulièrement les stocks pour maintenir un flux optimal des marchandises et tu participes aux inventaires
• Tu approvisionnes les chaînes de montage en matières premières et entreposes les produits finis au moyens d’appareils et d’engins de manutention de dernière génération
• Tu manipules, stockes et signales les produits chimiques ou dangereux
• Tu traites l’élimination des déchets et tu es attentif·ve à leur valorisation
• Tu prépares, emballes et charges les marchandises pour nos clients du monde entier Ton profil
• Tu as terminé ta scolarité obligatoire
• Tu t’intéresses à la logistique, à la mécanique et aux technologies modernes
• Tu apprécies être actif·ve et travailler dans un environnement industriel
• Tu as un bon sens de l’organisation et aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent
• Tu travailles avec soin, précision et rigueur

jobs.description:
Du liebst starke Maschinen, moderne Technik und abwechslungsreiche Einsätze? Dann bist du bei Liebherr genau richtig. Als Service-Techniker Autokrane sorgst du dafür, dass unsere modernsten Krane jederzeit einsatzbereit sind. Ob Inbetriebnahme von Neugeräten, technische Störungen oder anspruchsvolle Reparaturen – kein Tag ist wie der andere. Dich erwarten spannende Einsätze in der ganzen Schweiz, hohe Eigenverantwortung und direkter Kundenkontakt. Das sind deine Aufgaben
• Du stellst Neugeräte bereit, nimmst sie in Betrieb und führst Geräteübergaben sowie Einweisungen bei unseren Kunden durch.
• Du führst Service-, Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten an unseren Autokranen durch.
• Du analysierst technische Störungen und führst Reparaturen direkt beim Kunden oder an unserem Standort in Reiden aus.
• Du führst SUVA-Krankontrollen in der ganzen Schweiz durch.
• Du erledigst Garantiearbeiten sowie technische Änderungen gemäss den aktuellen Service-Informationen.
• Du berätst und unterstützt unsere Kunden kompetent vor Ort sowie telefonisch.
• Du dokumentierst deine Einsätze in Service-, Wartungs- und Inspektionsrapporten und koordinierst bei Bedarf Ersatzteile mit internen und externen Stellen.
• Du pflegst langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und repräsentierst Liebherr professionell bei jedem Einsatz. Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Landmaschinen-, Lastwagen-, Baumaschinenmechaniker EFZ, Automobil-Mechatroniker EFZ oder Motorgerätemechaniker EFZ.
• Idealerweise Erfahrung im technischen Servicebereich oder im Umfeld von Mobilbau- oder Autokranen. Motivierte Berufsleute mit Entwicklungspotenzial prüfen wir ebenfalls gerne.
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Französischkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.
• Führerausweis Kategorie B sowie idealerweise Kategorie E oder C beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben.
• Freude an direktem Kundenkontakt und selbstständigem Arbeiten.
• Bereitschaft für Reisetätigkeit in der ganzen Schweiz sowie gelegentliche Einsätze im angrenzenden Ausland.
• Wohnort vorzugsweise im Raum Bern, Zürich, Basel oder Luzern. Darauf kannst du dich freuen
• Ein kleines, schlagkräftiges Team mit grossem Zusammenhalt
• Eigener Servicewagen mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und laufende technische Weiterbildungen
• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über Deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG mit Sitz in Reiden (Schweiz) ist verantwortlich für den Vertrieb und Service von Erdbewegungs- und Materialumschlagmaschinen, Turmdrehkranen, Betontechnik, Spezialtiefbaumaschinen sowie Mobil- und Raupenkranen in der Schweiz. Standort Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ami macchine forti, tecnologia moderna e applicazioni varie? Allora sei esattamente al Liebherr. Come tecnico di servizio, si assicura che le nostre gru più moderne sono pronte per l'uso in ogni momento. Se commissionare nuove attrezzature, guasti tecnici o riparazioni esigenti – nessun giorno è come l'altro. Puoi aspettarti interessanti incarichi in tutta la Svizzera, alta responsabilità personale e contatto diretto con i clienti. Questi sono i tuoi compiti
• Fornire nuovi dispositivi, metterli in funzione e effettuare trasferimenti e istruzioni del dispositivo con i nostri clienti.
• Effettuate lavori di assistenza, manutenzione e ispezione sulle nostre gru.
• Analizzerai guasti tecnici e eseguirai riparazioni direttamente presso il cliente o presso la nostra sede a Reiden.
• Effettuate controlli su SUVA in tutta la Svizzera.
• L'utente completerà i lavori di garanzia e le modifiche tecniche in conformità alle attuali informazioni di servizio.
• Potrai consigliare e supportare i nostri clienti in modo competente in loco e per telefono.
• Se necessario, documentate le vostre assegnazioni in rapporti di servizio, manutenzione e ispezione e coordinate i pezzi di ricambio con organismi interni ed esterni.
• Mantenete relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e rappresentate Liebherr professionalmente in ogni compito. Lo porti con te.
• Formazione completa come macchine agricole, camion, macchinari per l'edilizia meccanica EFZ, meccanico automobilistico meccatronico EFZ o meccanica attrezzature motore EFZ.
• Idealmente, l'esperienza nel settore dei servizi tecnici o nel settore della costruzione mobile o delle car gru. Siamo anche lieti di esaminare professionisti motivati con potenziale di sviluppo.
• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza del francese. Altre lingue sono un plus.
• Patente di guida categoria B e idealmente Categoria E o C o la volontà di acquistarla.
• Godetevi il contatto diretto con i clienti e il lavoro indipendente.
• Prontezza per viaggiare in tutta la Svizzera e incarichi occasionali nei paesi vicini.
• Luogo di residenza preferibilmente nella zona di Berna, Zurigo, Basilea o Lucerna. Non vedo l'ora.
• Un team piccolo e potente con grande coesione
• Auto di servizio proprio con attrezzature moderne di lavoro
• Opportunità di sviluppo e formazione tecnica continua
• Condizioni di lavoro interessanti Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online. Per qualsiasi domanda, contattare Susanne Sulzer. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, con sede a Reiden (Svizzera), è responsabile per le vendite e il servizio di macchine movimento terra e movimentazione di materiali, gru a torre, tecnologia di cemento, speciali macchine edili sotterranee e gru mobili e crawler in Svizzera. Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Contatto Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00
descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you love strong machines, modern technology and varied applications? Then you are exactly right at Liebherr. As a service technician, you ensure that our most modern cranes are ready for use at all times. Whether commissioning new equipment, technical failures or demanding repairs – no day is like the other. You can expect exciting assignments throughout Switzerland, high personal responsibility and direct customer contact. These are your tasks
• You provide new devices, put them into operation and carry out device transfers and instructions with our customers.
• You carry out service, maintenance and inspection work on our car cranes.
• You will analyze technical faults and carry out repairs directly at the customer or at our location in Reiden.
• You carry out SUVA crane checks throughout Switzerland.
• You will complete warranty work and technical changes in accordance with the current service information.
• You will advise and support our customers competently on site and by telephone.
• You document your assignments in service, maintenance and inspection reports and coordinate spare parts with internal and external bodies if necessary.
• You maintain long-term customer relationships and represent Liebherr professionally in every assignment. You bring that with you
• Completed training as agricultural machinery, truck, construction machinery mechanic EFZ, automotive mechatronics mechanic EFZ or engine equipment mechanic EFZ.
• Ideally, experience in the technical service sector or in the field of mobile construction or car cranes. We are also happy to examine motivated professionals with development potential.
• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of French. Other languages are a plus.
• Category B driving licence and ideally Category E or C or the willingness to purchase it.
• Enjoy direct customer contact and independent work.
• Readiness for travel throughout Switzerland as well as occasional assignments in neighbouring countries.
• Place of residence preferably in the area of Bern, Zurich, Basel or Lucerne. You can look forward to that.
• A small, powerful team with great cohesion
• Own service car with modern work equipment
• Development opportunities and ongoing technical training
• Attractive employment conditions Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your online application. For any questions, please contact Susanne Sulzer. One passion. Many opportunities. The company Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, based in Reiden (Switzerland), is responsible for the sales and service of earthmoving and material handling machines, tower cranes, concrete technology, special underground construction machines and mobile and crawler cranes in Switzerland. Location Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Contact Susanne Sulzer 062 785 82 00

jobs.description:
Ihre Mission – Werden Sie Teil der Energiewende! Die Firmengruppe Liebherr ist aktive Gestalterin der Energiewende. Mit Schlüsselkomponenten für On‑ und Offshore Windturbinen – darunter Großwälzlager und Antriebe – leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Stromerzeugung und Energieversorgung weltweit. In Ihrer Rolle als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) Renewables – Wind Energy übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselposition in einem dynamischen Zukunftsmarkt: Sie tragen die globale Verantwortung für einen unserer strategisch bedeutenden AAA-Kunden, entwickeln diesen ganzheitlich weiter und gestalten langfristige, partnerschaftliche Geschäftsbeziehungen. Dabei verbinden Sie fundiertes Markt- und Produktverständnis mit unternehmerischem Denken und arbeiten eng mit unseren internationalen Teams zusammen. Ihr Fokus liegt darauf, echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden in der Windindustrie zu generieren. Dazu gehören auch spannende und zukunftsträchtige Projekte im Service bzw. Wind-Aftermarket. Aufgaben:
• Globale Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines umsatzstarken und strategisch wichtigen Kunden in der Windindustrie (Windturbinenhersteller)
• Ausarbeitung und Implementierung einer globalen Key Account Strategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Management, internen Fachbereichen und internationalen Vertriebs- und Produktionseinheiten
• Steuerung des operativen Geschäfts mit Einbindung in alle relevanten Schnittstellen und Herausforderungen (vom Forecasting über die Auftragsabwicklung bis hin zum Versand unserer Produkte)
• Enge, effektive und zielorientierte Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden aus dem Produktmanagement, Engineering, Produktion, Qualität, Supply Chain sowie internationalen Vertriebs- und Serviceeinheiten
• Souveräne und zielorientiert Angebots-, Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen (auch auf Management-Level) sowie Gestaltung langfristiger Vereinbarungen und Verträge
• Aufbau eines ganzheitlichen Markt- und Kundenverständnisses und Identifikation von Zukunftschancen und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – auch im Service und After Market Qualifikationen:
• Abgeschlossenes technisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Berufserfahrung im Bereich Vertrieb oder Key Account Management, idealerweise in den Bereichen Windenergie, erneuerbare Energien oder der Automobilbranche
• Erfahrung im internationalen Umfeld mit globalen Teams, Märkten und Kunden
• Authentisches Auftreten, kombiniert mit Empathie, Klarheit und Durchsetzungsvermögen
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
• Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Geschäftsreisen Unser Angebot: Wir bieten Ihnen mehr als nur einen Job. Wir schaffen gemeinsam Faszinierendes und bieten ein familiäres Umfeld innerhalb einer weltweit agierenden Firmengruppe. Neben der Möglichkeit, sich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, erwarten Sie u. a.:
• eine umfangreiche Einarbeitung und viel Handlungsspielraum
• flexible Arbeitszeiten
• vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktieren Sie bitte Jeton Tahiri. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen ​ Die 2011 gegründete Liebherr-Components AG ist als Handelsgesellschaft für den weltweiten Vertrieb von Komponenten und Systemlösungen der Firmengruppe zuständig. Ihr Portfolio umfasst Produkte aus dem Bereich mechanische, hydraulische und elektrische Antriebs- und Steuerungstechnik.​ Standort Liebherr-Components AG Brown Boveri Strasse 7 5400 Baden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Jeton Tahiri jeton.tahiri@liebherr.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
La vostra missione – Diventa parte della transizione energetica! Il Gruppo Liebherr è un progettista attivo della transizione energetica. Con i componenti chiave per turbine eoliche onshore e offshore – compresi i grandi cuscinetti e gli azionamenti – diamo un contributo decisivo alla produzione di energia sostenibile e all'approvvigionamento energetico in tutto il mondo. Nel ruolo di Key Account Manager (m/f/d) Rinnovabili – Energia eolica, assumerai una posizione chiave in un mercato dinamico futuro: Ti assumerai responsabilità globale per uno dei nostri clienti AAA strategicamente importanti, lo svilupperai in modo olistico e forma relazioni commerciali a lungo termine basate sulla partnership. Combinate il mercato del suono e la comprensione del prodotto con il pensiero imprenditoriale e lavorerete a stretto contatto con i nostri team internazionali. Il loro obiettivo è quello di generare valore aggiunto reale per i nostri clienti nel settore eolico. Questo include anche progetti entusiasmanti e promettenti nel servizio o post-vendita Wind. Compiti:
• Supporto globale e ulteriore sviluppo di un cliente ad alto rendimento e strategicamente importante nell'industria eolica (produttore di turbine eoliche)
• Sviluppo e attuazione di una strategia globale di contabilità chiave in stretta collaborazione con la nostra gestione, i dipartimenti interni e le unità di vendita e produzione internazionali
• Gestione del business operativo con integrazione in tutte le interfacce e le sfide rilevanti (dalla previsione al trattamento ordini alla spedizione dei nostri prodotti)
• Cooperazione stretta, efficace e orientata agli obiettivi con i dipendenti della gestione dei prodotti, dell'ingegneria, della produzione, della qualità, della supply chain e delle unità di vendita e di servizio internazionali
• Negoziati di offerta, prezzi e contratti sovrani e orientati agli obiettivi (anche a livello gestionale) e progettazione di accordi e contratti a lungo termine
• Costruire un mercato olistico e la comprensione del cliente e identificare le opportunità future e le opportunità di crescita – anche nelle qualifiche di servizio e post-mercato:
• Studi tecnici o aziendali completi o una qualifica comparabile
• Esperienza professionale nella gestione delle vendite o dei conti chiave, idealmente nei settori dell'energia eolica, delle energie rinnovabili o dell'industria automobilistica
• Esperienza in un ambiente internazionale con team, mercati e clienti globali
• Autentico aspetto combinato con empatia, chiarezza e assertività
• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura
• La nostra offerta: Vi offriamo più di un semplice lavoro. Insieme creiamo cose affascinanti e offriamo un ambiente familiare all'interno di un gruppo globale di aziende. Oltre all'opportunità di sviluppare sia professionalmente che personalmente, ci si può aspettare:
• una vasta familiarizzazione e un sacco di spazio per manovra
• Ore lavorative flessibili
• Varie opportunità di formazione e istruzione
• l'opportunità di lavorare mobile Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online. Per qualsiasi domanda, contattare Jeton Tahiri. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-Components AG, fondata nel 2011, è responsabile della distribuzione mondiale di componenti e soluzioni di sistema del gruppo di aziende. Il suo portafoglio comprende prodotti del settore della tecnologia meccanica, idraulica ed elettrica di azionamento e controllo. Liebherr-Components AG Brown Boveri Strasse 7 5400 Baden Svizzera (CH) Contatto Jeton Tahiri jeton.tahiri@liebherr.com
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your mission – Become part of the energy transition! The Liebherr Group is an active designer of the energy transition. With key components for onshore and offshore wind turbines – including large rolling bearings and drives – we make a decisive contribution to sustainable power generation and energy supply worldwide. In your role as Key Account Manager (m/f/d) Renewables – Wind Energy, you will assume a key position in a dynamic future market: You will bear global responsibility for one of our strategically important AAA customers, develop it holistically and shape long-term business relationships based on partnership. You will combine sound market and product understanding with entrepreneurial thinking and work closely with our international teams. Their focus is on generating real added value for our customers in the wind industry. This also includes exciting and promising projects in the service or Wind aftermarket. Tasks:
• Global support and further development of a high-turnover and strategically important customer in the wind industry (wind turbine manufacturer)
• Development and implementation of a global key account strategy in close cooperation with our management, internal departments and international sales and production units
• Management of the operational business with integration into all relevant interfaces and challenges (from forecasting to order processing to shipping of our products)
• Close, effective and goal-oriented cooperation with employees from product management, engineering, production, quality, supply chain as well as international sales and service units
• Sovereign and goal-oriented offer, price and contract negotiations (also at management level) as well as design of long-term agreements and contracts
• Building a holistic market and customer understanding and identifying future opportunities and growth opportunities – also in service and after-market qualifications:
• Completed technical or business studies or a comparable qualification
• Professional experience in sales or key account management, ideally in the areas of wind energy, renewable energies or the automotive industry
• Experience in an international environment with global teams, markets and customers
• Authentic appearance combined with empathy, clarity and assertiveness
• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing
• Readiness for (international) business travel Our offer: We offer you more than just a job. Together we create fascinating things and offer a family environment within a global group of companies. In addition to the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally, you can expect:
• an extensive familiarization and a lot of room for manoeuvre
• Flexible working hours
• Various training and education opportunities
• the opportunity to work mobile Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your online application. For any questions, please contact Jeton Tahiri. One passion. Many opportunities. The company Liebherr-Components AG, founded in 2011, is responsible as a trading company for the worldwide distribution of components and system solutions of the group of companies. Its portfolio includes products from the field of mechanical, hydraulic and electric drive and control technology. Location Liebherr-Components AG Brown Boveri Strasse 7 5400 Baden Switzerland (CH) Contact Jeton Tahiri jeton.tahiri@liebherr.com

Avec des composants clés pour les éoliennes terrestres et offshore – y compris de gros roulements et entraînements – nous apportons une contribution décisive à la production d'énergie durable et à l'approvisionnement énergétique dans le monde entier. Dans votre rôle de responsable de compte clé (h/f/d) Renewables – Wind Energy, vous occuperez une position clé dans un marché futur dynamique: Vous assumerez la responsabilité globale de l'un de nos clients AAA importants sur le plan stratégique, le développerez de façon holistique et façonnerez des relations d'affaires à long terme basées sur le partenariat. Vous combinerez une bonne compréhension du marché et des produits avec la pensée entrepreneuriale et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes internationales. Leur objectif est de générer une réelle valeur ajoutée pour nos clients de l'industrie éolienne. Cela inclut également des projets passionnants et prometteurs dans le service ou Wind après-vente. • Gestion de l'activité opérationnelle avec intégration à toutes les interfaces et défis pertinents (de la prévision au traitement des commandes à l'expédition de nos produits)

• Offre souveraine et orientée vers l'objectif, négociation de prix et de contrats (également au niveau de la direction) ainsi que conception d'accords et de contrats à long terme
• Bâtir un marché global et la compréhension des clients et identifier les opportunités futures et les opportunités de croissance – aussi dans le service et les qualifications après-vente:
• Études techniques ou commerciales complétées ou une qualification comparable
• Expérience professionnelle en vente ou gestion de compte clé, idéalement dans les domaines de l'énergie éolienne, des énergies renouvelables ou de l'industrie automobile
• Expérience dans un environnement international avec des équipes, des marchés et des clients mondiaux
• L'apparence authentique combinée à l'empathie, la clarté et l'affirmation
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

Ensemble, nous créons des choses fascinantes et offrons un environnement familial au sein d'un groupe mondial d'entreprises. Du liebst grosse Maschinen, schätzt die Abwechslung auf täglichen Baustellen und behältst auch in schwindelerregender Höhe immer einen kühlen Kopf? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als erfolgreiche Firmengruppe im Baubereich suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Team.
• Standort: 6260 Reiden (LU)
• Arbeitsstart: Ab Wohnort oder Reiden
• Einsatzgebiet: Ganze Schweiz

• Montage & Demontage: Du baust hochmoderne Liebherr Turmdrehkranen fachgerecht auf und ab
• Service vor Ort: Du übernimmst Reparaturen und die Wartung direkt auf Baustellen sowie auf Aussenlagerplätzen
• Werkstatt-Power: Du unterstützt unser Werkstatt-Team bei anfallenden Reparaturarbeiten
• Logistik & Teamarbeit: Du packst beim Be- und Entladen von Krankomponenten auf dem Lagerplatz tatkräftig mit an Das bringst du mit:

• Höhentauglichkeit: Du bist absolut schwindelfrei und das Arbeiten in der Höhe gewohnt
• Flexibilität: Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Schweiz und die Bereitschaft, gelegentlich auswärts zu übernachten
• Führerausweis: Du besitzt die Kategorie B (Kategorie BE für Anhänger ist ein grosses Plus)
• Persönlichkeit: Kundenorientiertes Denken und starker Teamgeist – du bist unser Gesicht direkt auf der Baustelle Das bieten wir dir:
• Spannung pur: Ein extrem abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag, an dem kein Tag wie der andere ist
• Moderne Kultur: Viel Flexibilität durch zeitgemässe Arbeitszeiten und eine top moderne Infrastruktur
• Gemeinsam stark: Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team in einer krisensicheren und erfolgreichen Firmengruppe
• Top Ausrüstung: Ein top eingerichteter, moderner Servicewagen steht für dich bereit
• Faire Konditionen: Attraktive Sozialleistungen, gute Benefits sowie eine zeitgemässe Spesenentschädigung
• Entwicklung: Fachliche Weiterbildung durch interne und externe Schulungen sowie gezielte Werksschulungen Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Mach deine Leidenschaft für Technik zum Beruf und werde Teil eines Teams, das Grosses bewegt. Bewirb dich jetzt online – wir freuen uns auf dich. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. Vuoi andare in alto? Inizia la tua carriera con noi! Ami le macchine grandi, apprezzi la varietà sui cantieri giornalieri e mantieni sempre una testa fresca anche alle altitudini vertiginose? Allora hai ragione con noi. Come gruppo aziendale di successo nel settore delle costruzioni, stiamo cercando rinforzi per il nostro team.
• Posizione: 6260 Riden (LU)
• Inizio del lavoro: Dal luogo di residenza o di equitazione
• Area di applicazione: Tutta la Svizzera
• Pensum: 100% Questo è ciò che fate con noi:
• Montaggio & smontaggio: Si costruisce e smontare le più moderne gru a torre Liebherr professionalmente
• Servizio in loco: Si prende il sopravvento riparazioni e manutenzione direttamente sui cantieri e sui siti di stoccaggio all'aperto
• Potenza dell'officina: Supporti il nostro team di officina in caso di lavori di riparazione
• Logistica & lavoro di squadra: Quando il carico e lo scarico componenti gru sul magazzino, si prende attivamente questo con voi:

Liebherr Machines Bulle SA forme des apprenti·es depuis 1981 et chaque année une vingtaine de jeunes obtiennent leur CFC après 3 ou 4 ans d'apprentissage dans notre entreprise. Tes missions :
• Tu fabriques des pièces, des outils et des dispositifs mécaniques

• Tu montres de l’intérêt pour la mécanique et la conception de pièces mécaniques
• Tu as une bonne capacité de représentation spatiale
• Tu fais preuve d’habileté manuelle, de dextérité et d’un bon esprit de collaboration
• Tu travailles avec soin, précision et exactitude
• Tu es doté·e d’un esprit logique et méthodique Notre offre : Dans notre atelier de production et grâce à divers stages en fabrication, tu bénéficieras d’une formation aussi complète que variée. Tes formateurs·trices sont qualifié·es et sauront t'encadrer et te soutenir tout au long de ton apprentissage. Pour la rentrée 2027, nous recherchons plusieurs apprenti·es et c'est avec plaisir que nous attendons ta postulation en ligne. Afin que nous puissions prendre en compte ta candidature, pense à joindre ton CV, ta lettre de motivation, les copies de tes résultats scolaires et autres diplômes. Date du contrat : du 1er août 2027 au 31 juillet 2030. Afin de garantir une procédure de candidature équitable, nous n’acceptons pas les candidatures par courrier postal ou électronique. En cas de questions, n'hésite pas à contacter Lea GRIVEL. One Passion. Many Opportunities. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. jobs.description:
The Head of Product Security is responsible for ensuring the cybersecurity of Liebherr Products/Machines and related digital products throughout their entire lifecycle. The role defines and drives product security strategy, embeds security-by-design into engineering, and ensures compliance with EU product cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and NIS2, while protecting connected machines, embedded systems, and digital services. Ensuring alignment with business strategies, demands, and risk appetite, working closely with Corporate Product Security Officer, as well as the Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. Responsibilities:
• Define and lead global product security strategy, roadmap and execution for construction machines and digital products.
• Define product security controls (secure coding, vulnerability management, incident response) based on threat modelling and risk appetite.
• Act as central focal point for product security topics within Corporate Information Security and to internal/external customers for product security matters, risk, regulatory findings
• Define the product security governance framework (policies, standards, controls) and ensure adoption into R&D, engineering, and product lifecycle processes
• Sponsor, build and deploy training, awareness, and support to Engineering teams on security best practices.
• Ensure product compliance with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable global regulations
• Embed security-by-design into hardware, firmware, embedded software, and connected platforms.
• Build, mentor and lead a team of product security experts. Foster collaboration with Engineering teams and across Corporate Information Security domains. Competencies:
• A degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in product or embedded cybersecurity, including 3+ years in a leadership role
• Strong background in embedded systems, connected products, or industrial/IoT security
• Proven ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into practical engineering execution
• Solid knowledge of standards and regulations such as UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Experience with security testing methods and tools (e.g. SAST, DAST, fuzzing)
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

Garantire l'allineamento con le strategie aziendali, le richieste e l'appetito del rischio, lavorando a stretto contatto con Corporate Product Security Officer, così come i Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. • Definieren Sie Produktsicherheitskontrollen (sichere Codierung, Schwachstellenmanagement, Incident Response) basierend auf Bedrohungsmodellierung und Risikobereitschaft.
• Handeln Sie als zentrale Anlaufstelle für Produktsicherheitsthemen innerhalb der Unternehmensinformationssicherheit und für interne/externe Kunden für Produktsicherheitsfragen, Risiko, regulatorische Erkenntnisse

• Gewährleistung der Produktkonformität mit dem EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2 und anderen geltenden globalen Vorschriften
• Einbetten von Security-by-Design in Hardware, Firmware, Embedded Software und verbundene Plattformen.
• Aufbau, Mentor und Leitung eines Teams von Produktsicherheitsexperten. Förderung der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-Teams und in allen Bereichen der Unternehmensinformationssicherheit. Kompetenzen:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Produkt- oder Embedded-Cybersicherheit, davon 3+ Jahre in einer Führungsrolle

• Erfahrung mit Security Testing Methoden und Tools (z.B. SAST, DAST, Fuzzing)
• Starke Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten
• Erfahrung in Fertigungs-, Industrie-, Automobil- oder Schwermaschinenumgebungen ist ein großer Vorteil

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le responsable de la sécurité des produits est chargé d'assurer la cybersécurité des produits/machines Liebherr et des produits numériques connexes tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Le rôle consiste à définir et à piloter la stratégie de sécurité des produits, à intégrer la sécurité par conception dans l'ingénierie et à assurer le respect des réglementations de l'UE en matière de cybersécurité des produits, notamment la Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) et NIS2, tout en protégeant les machines connectées, les systèmes embarqués et les services numériques. Assurer l'harmonisation avec les stratégies opérationnelles, les exigences et l'appétit pour les risques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'agent de la sécurité des produits de l'entreprise, ainsi qu'avec les agents de la sécurité des produits/ingénieurs des segments de produits. Responsabilités :
• Définir et diriger la stratégie mondiale de sécurité des produits, la feuille de route et l'exécution pour les machines de construction et les produits numériques.
• Définir les contrôles de sécurité des produits (codage sécurisé, gestion de la vulnérabilité, intervention en cas d'incident) en fonction de la modélisation des menaces et de l'appétit pour les risques.
• Agir en tant que point central pour les questions de sécurité des produits au sein de la Sécurité de l'information ministérielle et pour les clients internes/externes pour les questions de sécurité des produits, les risques, les constatations réglementaires
• Définir le cadre de gouvernance de la sécurité des produits (politiques, normes, contrôles) et assurer l'adoption dans les processus de R-D, d'ingénierie et de cycle de vie des produits
• Parrainer, développer et déployer la formation, la sensibilisation et le soutien aux équipes du génie sur les pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité.
• Assurer la conformité des produits avec la loi de l'UE sur la cyberrésilience (CRA), NIS2 et d'autres réglementations mondiales applicables
• Intégré sécurité par conception dans le matériel, le firmware, les logiciels intégrés et les plateformes connectées.
• Construire, encadrer et diriger une équipe d'experts en sécurité des produits. Favoriser la collaboration avec les équipes du génie et dans les domaines de la sécurité de l'information ministérielle. Compétences :
• Diplôme en génie, cybersécurité, informatique ou domaine connexe
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la cybersécurité intégrée, dont 3 ans et plus dans un rôle de leadership
• Un fond solide dans les systèmes embarqués, les produits connectés ou la sécurité industrielle/IoT
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire les exigences réglementaires et techniques en réalisation technique pratique
• Connaissance approfondie des normes et règlements tels que la norme CEE-ONU R155/R156, la norme de l ' UE pour l ' assurance maladie, la norme CEI 62443, la norme ISO 21434, la norme NIST CSF
• Expérience des méthodes et des outils d'essai de sécurité (p. ex. SAST, DAST, buzzing)
• Forte capacité de leadership, de communication et de gestion des intervenants
• L'expérience de la fabrication, de l'industrie, de l'automobile ou de l'équipement lourd est un avantage important
• Notre offre: Nous vous offrons un emploi sûr, progressif et favorable à la famille des conditions d'emploi telles que des horaires de travail flexibles, du travail hybride et des possibilités de formation continue. jobs.description:
Les missions
• Intervenir directement sur le terrain pour analyser et optimiser les processus de montage, réduire les temps de cycle de production et mettre en place des standards de chronométrage
• Réaliser des études de postes et des analyses de flux afin d’identifier les gaspillages et proposer des améliorations concrètes
• Effectuer des cartographies de la chaîne de valeur (VSM) en collaboration avec les équipes terrain
• Évaluer les coûts de production et contribuer à la planification en définissant des temps standards cibles réalistes
• Recommander et mettre en place des améliorations ergonomiques, sécuritaires et organisationnelles
• Définir et déployer des bonnes pratiques industrielles standardisées et durables
• Former et accompagner les opérateurs et responsables à l’adoption des nouveaux standards et méthodes
• Documenter les processus pour assurer la continuité opérationnelle et le transfert de connaissances Profil
• Formation d'ingénieur en génie mécanique ou en génie de production
• Bonne connaissance des processus de fabrication et d’assemblage des moteurs
• Compétences en chronométrage et analyse de temps de travail
• Maîtrise du français et connaissance de l'anglais et/ou de l'allemand
• Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe Notre offre Pour ce poste ouvert uniquement à l'interne, LMB propose une formation interne pour monter en compétences sur le poste :
• • Technicien REFA en Industrial Engineering
• Methods Time Measurement (MTM-1, MTM-2 et MTM-UAS)
• Accompagnement des analyses par du coaching si nécessaire Une convention de formation pour la prise en charge des coûts sera établie entre LMB et la personne qui occupera ce poste d'une durée de 3 ans. Avons-nous suscité votre intérêt ? Si c’est le cas, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez contacter Romain GROGNUZ. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *Une passion commune. Tant d’opportunités. L'entreprise Liebherr Machines Bulle SA est le centre de compétences des moteurs à combustion (diesel et gaz) et composants hydrauliques. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. ​​ Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Suisse (CH) Contact Romain GROGNUZ 026 913 31 11

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You take ownership of system-level control design (design, simulation, V&V, …), contributing to next-generation engine control architectures and digital engineering capabilities
• You collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, experts, and customers
• You design, implement, and maintain model-based plant/system models and Model‑in‑the‑Loop (MiL) simulation environments to systematically test, analyze, and validate control functions
• You perform evidence-based trade‑off analyses to evaluate and optimize alternative technical solutions
• You support application engineers during commissioning activities at test benches and in real-world field applications
• You define system-level control specifications, including failure mode analysis, safety and cybersecurity considerations
• You analyze, evaluate and document the dynamic behavior and interactions of engine control system elements
• You design, develop and maintain engine control system architectures (hardware, software and services) with a focus on performance, quality and reusability
• You coordinate with project management and software/hardware development teams to integrate new functions and components, and continuously improve model-based systems engineering methods, processes and toolchains Your Profile
• You have successfully completed engineering studies in the field of automotive, powertrain, mechanical, mechatronics, electronics engineering, or similar
• You have solid experience in combustion engine control system development, including multi‑physics modeling, and ideally engine calibration (performance and emissions)
• You are proficient in Matlab/Simulink and embedded software engineering, with strong skills in model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) and signal processing
• You are familiar with ALM/PLM and requirements authoring tools, and MBSE environments such as System Composer, Cameo, Rhapsody or similar
• You bring an analytical mindset, high learnability, agile methods, and collaborate effectively in cross‑functional engineering teams
• You are willing and able to occasionally travel
• You are fluent in English Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 34 00

• Si prende la proprietà di progettazione di controllo a livello di sistema (design, simulazione, V&V, ...), contribuendo a architetture di controllo del motore di nuova generazione e capacità di ingegneria digitale
• Collabora con team, esperti e clienti multidisciplinari
• Progettare, implementare e mantenere modelli di impianto/sistema basati sul modello e ambienti di simulazione Model-in-the-Loop (MiL) per testare, analizzare e convalidare sistematicamente le funzioni di controllo
• Esegui analisi di trade-off basate su prove per valutare e ottimizzare soluzioni tecniche alternative
• Supporti gli ingegneri delle applicazioni durante le attività di messa in servizio presso banchi di prova e in applicazioni sul campo del mondo reale
• Definisci le specifiche di controllo a livello di sistema, tra cui analisi delle modalità di fallimento, considerazioni di sicurezza e sicurezza informatica
• Si analizza, valuta e documenta il comportamento dinamico e le interazioni degli elementi del sistema di controllo del motore
• Progetti, sviluppi e mantieni architetture del sistema di controllo del motore (hardware, software e servizi) con un focus sulle prestazioni, qualità e riutilizzabilità
• Si coordina con team di gestione del progetto e sviluppo software/hardware per integrare nuove funzioni e componenti e migliorare continuamente metodi di ingegneria dei sistemi basati sul modello, processi e toolchains
• Hai completato con successo gli studi di ingegneria nel campo dell'automotive, del powertrain, della meccanica, della meccatronica, dell'ingegneria elettronica, o simili
• Hai una solida esperienza nello sviluppo del sistema di controllo dei motori a combustione, tra cui la modellazione multi-fisica e la calibrazione del motore idealmente (performance ed emissioni)
• Sei abile in Matlab/Simulink e ingegneria software incorporata, con forti competenze nell'ingegneria dei sistemi basata sui modelli (MBSE) e nell'elaborazione dei segnali
• Hai familiarità con ALM/PLM e requisiti che autorizzano strumenti e ambienti MBSE come System Composer, Cameo, Rhapsody o simili
• Porti una mentalità analitica, un'elevata capacità di apprendimento, metodi agili e collabori efficacemente in team di ingegneria interfunzionali
• Siete disposti e in grado di viaggiare occasionalmente

• Sie arbeiten mit multidisziplinären Teams, Experten und Kunden zusammen

• Sie führen evidenzbasierte Trade-off-Analysen durch, um alternative technische Lösungen zu bewerten und zu optimieren
• Sie unterstützen Anwendungstechniker bei der Inbetriebnahme auf Prüfständen und in realen Feldanwendungen
• Sie definieren Steuerungsspezifikationen auf Systemebene, einschließlich Fehlermodusanalyse, Sicherheits- und Cybersicherheitsüberlegungen
• Sie analysieren, bewerten und dokumentieren das dynamische Verhalten und die Interaktionen von Motorsteuersystemelementen
• Sie entwerfen, entwickeln und pflegen Motorsteuerungsarchitekturen (Hardware, Software und Services) mit Fokus auf Leistung, Qualität und Wiederverwendbarkeit
• Sie stimmen sich mit Projektmanagement- und Software-/Hardwareentwicklungsteams ab, um neue Funktionen und Komponenten zu integrieren und modellbasierte System-Engineering-Methoden, Prozesse und Toolchains kontinuierlich zu verbessern Ihr Profil
• Sie haben erfolgreich ein Ingenieurstudium im Bereich Automotive, Antriebsstrang, Mechanik, Mechatronik, Elektroniktechnik oder ähnliches abgeschlossen
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Verbrennungsmotorsteuerungssystemen, einschließlich Multiphysik-Modellierung und idealerweise Motorkalibrierung (Leistung und Emissionen)
• Sie beherrschen Matlab/Simulink und Embedded Software Engineering und verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in modellbasiertem Systems Engineering (MBSE) und Signalverarbeitung
• Sie kennen ALM/PLM und Requirements Authoring Tools sowie MBSE-Umgebungen wie System Composer, Cameo, Rhapsody oder ähnliches.
• Sie bringen eine analytische Denkweise, hohe Lernfähigkeit, agile Methoden mit und arbeiten effektiv in funktionsübergreifenden Engineering-Teams zusammen
• Sie sind bereit und in der Lage, gelegentlich zu reisen

jobs.description:
We are expanding our Global Corporate Information Security Team and looking forward new colleagues and leaders joining us in Bulle (FR) Switzerland, we are looking for a Head of Data Security reporting to Head of Digital Security at Liebherr International. The scope of duties includes the following: Responsibilities: Oversees the organization’s global data security strategy and implementation to protect sensitive data assets across IT, OT and Cloud Environments, as well as Global Leadership of Data Security Team, Products and Services.
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data security strategy aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee data security, labeling, and access control mechanisms in collaboration with Data Governance.
• Implement and manage data encryption and data loss prevention (DLP) solutions.
• Manage data encryption and key management systems (e.g. PKI)
• Develop and enforce data protection strategies, and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR) in collaboration with Data Protection.
• Conduct regular risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities in data storage, processing, and transmission.
• Collaborate with IT, legal, and business teams to secure sensitive data across all platforms.
• Manage incident response for data breaches, including investigation, remediation, and reporting.
• Implement monitoring and technical auditing mechanisms to track data access and usage across the organization.
• Drive data security awareness and training programs to reinforce best practices among employees. Competencies:
• Bachelor’s/Master’s in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
• 5+ years in cybersecurity and 3+ years in a leadership role.
• Following certificates are preferred; CISSP or CISM.
• English is a Must, German and French are a plus.
• Excellent knowledge of data security concepts, principles including data governance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
• Knowledge of data security technologies and tools (e.g., DLP, cloud encryption, tokenization).
• Experience with cryptographic solutions and protocols (e.g., PKI, PGP, KMS, HSM)
• Ability to think critically and solve complex problems
• Ability to communicate technical topics to non-technical audiences
• Ability to manage and collaborate with stakeholders
• Project management
• Readiness for global travel Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

• Superare i meccanismi di sicurezza, etichettatura e controllo degli accessi in collaborazione con Data Governance.

• Guidare la consapevolezza della sicurezza dei dati e programmi di formazione per rafforzare le migliori pratiche tra i dipendenti. Competenze:
• Corso di laurea / Master in Cybersecurity, Informatica, o campo relativo.
• 5+ anni in sicurezza informatica e 3+ anni in un ruolo di leadership.

• Esperienza con soluzioni e protocolli crittografici (ad esempio PKI, PGP, KMS, HSM)

jobs.description:
Tasks:
• Act as a partner to finance teams across the group, translating business requirements into robust Tagetik solutions across Consolidation, Planning, ESG, and Pillar 2 modules
• Design, build, and optimize Tagetik configurations, data flows, and reporting logic — hands-on
• Drive automation and integration between Tagetik, our ERP landscape, and BI tools, replacing manual interfaces with governed, scalable data flows
• Strengthen data governance and data integrity across the group's financial reporting processes, together with finance, IT, and operations
• Train and support key users worldwide, and act as the recognized Tagetik authority within the group Qualifications:
• You hold a degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, combined with proven delivery experience
• 5+ years of experience with CPM platforms in complex, multi-entity environments
• Deep, hands-on Tagetik expertise — this is non-negotiable. You have delivered at least one end-to-end consolidation or planning solution on Tagetik and can prove it
• Solid understanding of group accounting and consolidation logic (IFRS environment)
• Fluent English; German is a strong asset for daily work in Switzerland, French a plus
• Structured project mindset — you can hold your own in a large implementation with many moving parts Our offer:
• A rare chance to work on a full-scope Tagetik implementation at genuine group scale — the kind of project most specialists only see from the consulting side
• A permanent, in-house position with the stability of a family-owned group and none of the utilization pressure of consulting
• Hybrid working environment and advantageous benefits
• A small, senior corporate team where your expertise is visible and your decisions carry weight Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG General-Guisanstrasse 6 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga Regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

• Hai una laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo correlato, combinato con comprovata esperienza di consegna
• 5+ anni di esperienza con piattaforme CPM in ambienti complessi e multi-entity

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You lead the development of Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems (EATS) from requirements and system design through testing, validation and PPAP
• You define technical specifications and requirements for EATS components and ensure their alignment with project targets
• You plan and coordinate development and validation activities, including test plans, prototype and calibration maturity, measurements and resources
• You coordinate EATS testing on engine test benches, analyses results and drive troubleshooting and problem-solving activities
• You manage DVPnR (Design Verification Plan and Reporting) activities and support Quality Gates, ensuring validation status, risks and deliverables are properly monitored and documented
• You work closely with Engine Development, Design, Purchasing and Quality to develop and integrate EATS solutions
• You act as the technical reference for EATS suppliers, from technology evaluation and component development to technical troubleshooting and 8D activities
• You contribute to the definition and maintenance of EATS-related software and technical documentation, and report development status to the project team Your Profile
• You have 3–5 years of experience in EATS, exhaust system or hardware development, ideally in the field of internal combustion engines
• You have solid knowledge of exhaust aftertreatment systems and catalyst technologies; experience with DEF dosing systems is an advantage
• You have experience in EATS testing, validation and calibration, including test planning, measurement and data analysis
• You have knowledge of EATS simulation (1D/3D, with basic CFD knowledge), FMEA and DVPnR methodology
• You are familiar with measurement and data acquisition tools such as CSM, Vector or ETAS and have a basic understanding of automotive software
• You have a structured and analytical approach to troubleshooting, enjoy working cross-functionally and are comfortable coordinating technical topics with suppliers Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 34 00

descriptionByLocale.it:
Le tue responsabilità
• Conduci lo sviluppo di sistemi di posttrattamento di scarico (EATS) da requisiti e progettazione di sistema attraverso test, validazione e PPAP
• Definisci specifiche tecniche e requisiti per i componenti EATS e garantisci il loro allineamento con gli obiettivi di progetto
• Pianifica e coordina le attività di sviluppo e validazione, compresi i piani di prova, la maturità del prototipo e della calibrazione, le misurazioni e le risorse
• Coordinate i test EATS sui banchi di prova del motore, analizza i risultati e guida le attività di risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione dei problemi
• Gestisci le attività di DVPnR (Design Verification Plan and Reporting) e supporta i Quality Gates, assicurando lo stato di validazione, i rischi e i deliverable sono adeguatamente monitorati e documentati
• Lavori a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo del motore, il design, l'acquisto e la qualità per sviluppare e integrare le soluzioni EATS
• L'utente agisce come riferimento tecnico per i fornitori EATS, dalla valutazione della tecnologia e sviluppo dei componenti alla risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e alle attività 8D
• Contribuisci alla definizione e alla manutenzione del software e della documentazione tecnica EATS, e segnala lo stato di sviluppo al team di progetto
• Hai 3-5 anni di esperienza in EATS, sistema di scarico o sviluppo hardware, idealmente nel campo dei motori a combustione interna
• Hai una solida conoscenza dei sistemi di posttrattamento degli scarichi e delle tecnologie di catalizzatore; l'esperienza con i sistemi di dosaggio DEF è un vantaggio
• Hai esperienza nel test, nella validazione e nella calibrazione di EATS, inclusa la pianificazione di test, la misurazione e l'analisi dei dati
• Hai conoscenza della simulazione EATS (1D/3D, con la conoscenza CFD di base), metodologia FMEA e DVPnR
• Hai familiarità con strumenti di misura e di acquisizione dati come CSM, Vector o ETAS e hai una comprensione di base del software automobilistico
• Hai un approccio strutturato e analitico per risolvere i problemi, godere di lavorare in modo trasversale e sono comodi coordinare argomenti tecnici con i fornitori La nostra offerta Possiamo ispirarti a prendere una posizione responsabile in un business familiare dinamico e indipendente? Vi offriamo spazio per idee, un lavoro sicuro, condizioni di lavoro moderne e familiari come orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio di casa, un ristorante aziendale, opportunità di formazione e molti benefici. Il posto di lavoro si trova a Bulle, circondato dalla natura meravigliosa della regione di Gruyère. Inizia a pianificare il tuo sviluppo personale e professionale con noi. Al fine di garantire un corretto processo di applicazione, non possiamo accettare le applicazioni per posta o e-mail. Questa posizione è soggetta a un processo di controllo di sfondo; il processo è condotto dal nostro partner Aequivalent. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Se hai domande, contatta Sylvain STUDER. Una Passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per motori a combustione (diesel e motori a gas) e componenti idraulici (pompe a pistoni assiali e motori). L'azienda sviluppa e produce vari prodotti, che trovano il loro uso nella costruzione e nell'ingegneria civile, nell'estrazione mineraria, nell'agricoltura, nell'energia decentralizzata, nell'ingegneria delle macchine e degli impianti, nonché nell'aerospaziale. descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihre Aufgaben
• Sie führen die Entwicklung von Abgasnachbehandlungssystemen (EATS) von Anforderungen und Systemdesign über Test, Validierung und PPAP
• Sie definieren technische Spezifikationen und Anforderungen für EATS-Komponenten und stellen deren Ausrichtung auf Projektziele sicher
• Sie planen und koordinieren Entwicklungs- und Validierungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Testpläne, Prototyp- und Kalibrierungsreife, Messungen und Ressourcen
• Sie koordinieren EATS-Tests auf Motorprüfständen, analysieren Ergebnisse und treiben Fehlersuche und Problemlösungsaktivitäten
• Sie verwalten DVPnR-Aktivitäten (Design Verification Plan and Reporting) und unterstützen Quality Gates, um sicherzustellen, dass Validierungsstatus, Risiken und Ergebnisse ordnungsgemäß überwacht und dokumentiert werden.
• Sie arbeiten eng mit Motorenentwicklung, Design, Einkauf und Qualität zusammen, um EATS-Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu integrieren
• Sie fungieren als technische Referenz für EATS-Lieferanten, von der Technologiebewertung und Komponentenentwicklung bis hin zur technischen Fehlersuche und 8D-Aktivitäten
• Sie tragen zur Definition und Pflege von EATS-bezogener Software und technischer Dokumentation bei und melden dem Projektteam Ihren Entwicklungsstand
• Sie haben 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in EATS, Abgassystem oder Hardwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Bereich Verbrennungsmotoren
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über Abgasnachbehandlungssysteme und Katalysatortechnologien; Erfahrung mit DEF-Dosiersystemen ist von Vorteil
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit EATS-Tests, Validierung und Kalibrierung, einschließlich Testplanung, Messung und Datenanalyse
• Sie haben Kenntnisse in EATS-Simulation (1D/3D, mit grundlegenden CFD-Kenntnissen), FMEA und DVPnR-Methodik
• Sie sind mit Mess- und Datenerfassungstools wie CSM, Vector oder ETAS vertraut und haben ein Grundverständnis für Automotive Software
• Sie haben einen strukturierten und analytischen Ansatz zur Fehlersuche, arbeiten gerne funktionsübergreifend und koordinieren gerne technische Themen mit Lieferanten Unser Angebot Können wir Sie dazu inspirieren, eine verantwortungsvolle Position in einem dynamischen und unabhängigen Familienunternehmen einzunehmen? Wir bieten Ihnen Raum für Ideen, einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, moderne und familienfreundliche Beschäftigungsbedingungen wie flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home Office, ein Betriebsrestaurant, Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie viele Vorteile. Der Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Bulle, umgeben von der wunderbaren Natur der Region Gruyère. Planen Sie mit uns Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Um einen fairen Bewerbungsprozess zu gewährleisten, können wir keine Bewerbungen per Post oder E-Mail annehmen. Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Wenn Sie Fragen haben, wenden Sie sich bitte an Sylvain STUDER. Eine Leidenschaft. Viele Möglichkeiten. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert verschiedene Produkte, die ihren Einsatz im Hoch- und Tiefbau, Bergbau, Landwirtschaft, dezentrale Energie, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie in der Luft- und Raumfahrt finden. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vos responsabilités
• Vous dirigez le développement de systèmes de post-traitement des gaz d'échappement (EATS) à partir des exigences et de la conception du système par des tests, validation et PPAP
• Vous définissez les spécifications techniques et les exigences pour les composants EATS et assurez leur alignement avec les objectifs du projet
• Vous planifiez et coordonnez les activités de développement et de validation, y compris les plans d'essais, la maturité du prototype et de l'étalonnage, les mesures et les ressources

jobs.title: Group Senior Internal Auditor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Die Liebherr-International AG ist die Dachgesellschaft der Firmengruppe Liebherr. Die Konzernrevision unterstützt Verwaltungsrat, Geschäftsleitung und Management durch unabhängige Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen bei der Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Risiko- und Kontrollsystemen. As a Group Senior Internal Auditor, you will contribute to transparency, integrity, and sustainable business success across the Liebherr Group. Beyond evaluating processes and controls, you will act as a trusted advisor to management and support strategic improvement initiatives worldwide. Your Responsibilities:
• Independently plan and perform international audit engagements covering finance, operations, compliance, and governance topics
• Assess business processes, risks, and internal control systems to identify opportunities for improvement
• Develop practical and value-adding recommendations that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance
• Advise management on corporate governance, risk management, and internal control matters
• Support transformation initiatives, special projects, and strategic business developments from an audit and risk perspective
• Leverage data analytics and modern audit methodologies to enhance audit effectiveness and coverage
• Prepare concise, insightful, and audience-focused audit reports and present findings to local and senior management
• Monitor and evaluate the implementation of agreed corrective actions Your Profile:
• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, consulting, or a comparable role
• Professional certification such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) is preferred
• Strong understanding of business processes, governance structures, risk management, and internal controls
• High affinity for digital technologies, data analytics, and process automation
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with sound business judgment
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels
• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently in an international environment
• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are an advantage
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30% Our Offer: Could we inspire you to take on a responsible role in a dynamic and independent family-owned company? We offer you the freedom to contribute your ideas, a secure workplace, and modern, family-friendly employment conditions, including flexible working hours, home office options, and opportunities for professional development and further training. What We Offer
• A challenging and rewarding role within a leading global family-owned industrial group
• Exposure to a wide range of businesses, industries, processes, and international environments
• Direct interaction with senior management and key decision-makers across the Group
• Opportunities to work on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and emerging business risks
• A modern audit function that embraces innovation, data analytics, and continuous improvement
• Attractive career development opportunities within Internal Audit and across the wider Liebherr Group
• A collaborative culture that values integrity, curiosity, teamwork, and entrepreneurial thinking Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG General-Guisanstrasse 6 5415 Nussbaumen Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

jobs.title: Product Safety Specialist (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You apply and promote risk assessment processes in accordance with EN ISO 12100 and ensure their consistent application
• You coordinate the implementation of product risk assessments in collaboration with engineering and other relevant departments
• You ensure the implementation of applicable product safety requirements, guidelines and standards
• You support communication with customers and external stakeholders on product safety and risk assessment topics for specific projects
• You use your broad technical understanding to identify potential risks across mechanical, electrical, software and other technical aspects of our products
• You contribute to technical discussions and challenge existing solutions constructively from a product safety perspective Your Profile
• You have completed technical education or vocational training in a relevant field
• You have several years of professional experience in an industrial environment, ideally in machinery or heavy-duty equipment, basic knowledge in combustion engine technologies is an advantage
• You have a broad technical understanding covering areas such as technical drawings, mechanical design, hardware/software development and other relevant technologies
• You have practical knowledge of product safety and risk assessment, including experience with EN ISO 12100
• You have a good understanding of international product safety requirements and can translate them into practical solutions
• You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable working beyond your initial area of expertise
• You are confident and assertive in discussions, while remaining constructive and solution-oriented
• You are used to work autonomously, focused on clear targets
• You are team player with focus, finding together the best solution while maintaining the safety goals as defined in the Risk Assessment Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Sylvain STUDER +41 26 913 34 00
